title: Running, but the page won't open
summary: The container is up and happy, but the browser gets nothing. Find out which door the app really uses.

tasks.title: `http://localhost:8098` shows the Quiet app
tasks.hint: `docker logs quiet` shows the port the app listens on inside. The right side of `-p` must be that port: `-p 8098:<that port>`. Remove the old container first: `docker rm -f quiet`.

tasks.title: The container is still called `quiet` and made from `quiet-app`
The code is unchanged: the app still listens on 5000
tasks.hint: Fix it with the `docker run` command, not by changing `app.js`. Put `const PORT = 5000;` back.
